engineering_model.organizational_role: Engineering organization, roles, lifecycle processes, work products and evidence structure

medical_acceptance_model.governing_rule: Medical product acceptance governs classification, risk acceptability, verification, validation and final release; Automotive SPICE capability does not constitute medical product approval.
candidate_source_families: Applicable medical-device or in-vitro-diagnostic law by target market
IEC 62304 medical-device software lifecycle when applicable
IEC 61010 series and applicable product-specific parts for laboratory equipment
Product-specific usability, performance, cybersecurity and post-market obligations when applicable

one_binary_strategy.principle: One released platform binary is reused across centrifuge products.
one_binary_strategy.product_adaptation: Controlled parameter and production-data packages; no product source-code fork by default.
one_binary_strategy.system_acceptance_rule: Each system project verifies and medically accepts its exact binary, parameter package, hardware and intended-use combination.

open_decisions: Confirm that HBI-High-Premium is a system-level project.
Classify each product family and product by intended use, claims and target market; Medical/Bio use alone does not establish a regulatory class.
Approve the applicable medical acceptance source matrix and editions per product.
Confirm the intended Automotive SPICE 4.1 process scope and capability targets per project.
Confirm whether BZS is the only OneBinary platform subsystem or one of several subsystem platforms.
